text_en: Wind data shows that as of the end of the third quarter, QFIIs held a total of 1,309 A-shares. Of these, 752 stocks rose in the third quarter, accounting for 57.4%, with an average gain of 5.66%, outperforming the Shanghai Composite Index by 11.82 percentage points and the ChiNext Index by 33.46 percentage points. Among them, 67 stocks rose more than 50% and 25 doubled. Among the QFII-held stocks that rose more than 50% in the third quarter, by SW Level-1 industry classification, pharmaceuticals and biotechnology had the most, at 13 stocks, accounting for 26%, with an average gain of 102%; basic chemicals had 5; home appliances, electronics, agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fisheries, and light industry manufacturing each had 4; food and beverage and real estate each had 3. Bank stocks were the main source of QFII profits in the third quarter.
